status: operators frozen before execution; aggregation roles corrected after independent review
time_basis: fixed local standard time; no interval-start shift for instantaneous tcc
daily_requirements: 24 complete ERA5 hours and 24 complete comparator hours
primary_era_daily_operator: 24-hour arithmetic mean tcc; independent of realized shortwave
sensitivity_era_daily_operator: valid-time-associated preceding-hour realized-ssrd-weighted tcc; outcome-dependent and mathematically coupled to the shortwave residual, never independent sanity evidence
ssrd_boundary_rule: the realized-ssrd sensitivity groups weights on tcc valid-time date and requires every local-midnight preceding-hour ssrd value to be zero; the primary tcc lane has no radiation weighting
winter_event_rule: complete November-March local-standard day with retained comparator precipitation > 0
residual_rule: ERA minus retained proxy; shortwave residual is ERA horizontal daily energy minus retained .cli horizontal daily rad
claim_limit: sanity/association only; no observation validation, causation, provider admission, or snow-model improvement
